observation.command:
cat > /etc/xplanbox.env <<'EOF'
export DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree
export XPLANBOX_CONFIG=/opt/xplanbox/xplan-manager-config
export XPLAN_DB_HOSTNAME=localhost
export XPLAN_DB_PORT=5432
export XPLAN_DB_NAME=xplanbox
export XPLAN_DB_USER=xplanbox
export XPLAN_DB_PASSWORD=xplanbox
export XPLAN_DB_INIT_USER=initxplanbox
export XPLAN_DB_INIT_PASSWORD=initxplanbox
export XPLAN_RABBIT_HOST=localhost
export XPLAN_RABBIT_USER=xplanbox
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PASSWORD=xplanbox
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PUBLIC_TOPIC=latlon.xplanbox.public
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PUBLIC_TOPIC_ROUTINGPREFIX=xplanbox.
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_ANONYMOUSQUEUES_PREFIX=latlon.xplanbox.private-
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_TOPIC=latlon.private
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_TOPIC_ROUTINGPREFIX=xplanbox.
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_WORKQUEUE_IMPORT=latlon.xplanbox.private.import
export XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_WORKQUEUE_VALIDATION=latlon.xplanbox.private.validation
export XPLAN_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT=900000
export XPLAN_S3_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
export XPLAN_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
export XPLAN_S3_REGION=eu-central-1
export XPLAN_S3_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:9000
export XPLAN_S3_PATHSTYLEACCESS_ENABLED=true
export XPLAN_S3_BUCKET_ATTACHMENTS=xplan-attachments
export XPLAN_S3_BUCKET_VALIDATION=xplan-validation
export XPLAN_S3_BUCKET_MAPPROXYCACHE=xplan-mapproxycache
EOF
echo "xplanbox" > /opt/deegree/config.apikey
source /etc/xplanbox.env && echo "env OK: $DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT / $XPLANBOX_CONFIG"; date +%H:%M:%S; grep -cE "Building " /workspace/build.log; tail -2 /workspace/build.log | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'
